warning: Bridlewise is an experimental developer preview. Do not paste credentials, private source, personal data, absolute home paths or database contents. Paste logs as text (file uploads are not accepted); a secret found in an intake is redacted by the publisher.

issueForms.name: Bug report
issueForms.description: Report a reproducible problem in the developer preview.

fields.label: Reproduction
fields.description: Exact steps and commands, and a minimal disposable project if one is needed.

fields.label: Actual behavior
fields.description: Include the typed error or refusal text, not a screenshot of a stack trace.

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: OS, kernel, Node version, npm version, browser.

fields.label: Redacted logs
fields.description: Remove secrets, tokens, private paths and personal data first.

issueForms.name: Flake report
issueForms.description: A test that passed and failed on the same tree. Name the test, so a triager can run /reproduce.

fields.label: Test file
fields.description: The repository-relative path of the test file. /reproduce runs this path only; free-text steps are never executed.

fields.label: Test name
fields.description: The test's name as the runner printed it.

fields.label: Revision
fields.description: The commit SHA both runs used.

fields.label: What you saw
fields.description: The failing assertion or refusal text, and how often it failed.

fields.label: Run link
fields.description: A link to the failing CI run, if there is one.

issueForms.name: Docs fix
issueForms.description: A page that is wrong, stale, unclear or missing.

fields.label: Page
fields.description: The repository path or site URL of the page.

confirmations: I searched existing issues and discussions.
This report contains no credentials, private source or personal data.
I understand this is a developer preview with no support SLA.

contactLinks.name: Feature idea
contactLinks.about: Propose a capability in Ideas; a triager can /track it into a record.

contactLinks.name: Question
contactLinks.about: Ask in Q&A; answers are marked by maintainers and reviewers.

contactLinks.name: Security report
contactLinks.about: Report a vulnerability privately. Never open a public issue with exploit details.

discussionCategories.name: Announcements
discussionCategories.use: milestone closes, major changes and the pinned "Follow along" thread

discussionCategories.name: Floor log
discussionCategories.use: one thread per milestone and one comment per land

discussionCategories.name: Decisions
discussionCategories.use: one thread per decision record; everyone can comment, and a triager can /track an objection into a record

discussionCategories.name: RFCs
discussionCategories.use: a proposal for a new decision; an accepted RFC becomes a decision-record pull request

fields.label: Proposal
fields.description: The behavior and its invariants, not only the implementation.

fields.label: Which rules it touches
fields.description: The decision records (docs/decisions/) this would add, change or supersede.

discussionCategories.name: Ideas
discussionCategories.use: a capability you would like; a triager can /track it into a record

fields.label: Problem
fields.description: What can a user not do or not understand today?

discussionCategories.name: Q&A
discussionCategories.use: questions; answers are marked by maintainers and reviewers

discussionCategories.name: Show and tell
discussionCategories.use: your own uses of the harness

discussionCategories.name: Polls
discussionCategories.use: sentiment checks; results are signals, never decisions
